summary: Parses a track AI waypoint database file (.AIW) into the track database object. Reads FEATURES (pit lane, starting grid, pit/garage spot counts with minimum clamps), GRID (grid position triples), PITS (team-indexed pit/garage positions and orientations), and per-waypoint properties (branch id, path, event, score, width, groove, bitfields, pointer set). Allocates the waypoint array from the parsed count (316-byte stride plus 4-byte header), falls back to a default two-waypoint array when no count is parsed, remaps indexes, and post-processes each waypoint position delta.

operations.description: Release the target's existing per-track arrays before reparsing.
Allocate the mesh buffers referenced by the track database after the reset.
Clear the left-handed-pit flag field (init literal 0).
If the input file handle is null, skip parsing and jump to the default waypoint init block.
Outer loop: read one line at a time from the waypoint database file via the read-until-newline helper.
Detect the FEATURES section token and enter the feature-parameter parsing loop.
Read feature-section lines until the section-marker token is found.
Tokenize the current line; the returned marker decides whether to stop the section.
Parse the PITLANES token into the pit-lane count field.
Parse the STARTINGGRID token into the starting-grid count field.
Clamp the starting-grid count field to a minimum of 104.
Apply the clamped starting-grid count (minimum 104).
Parse the PITSPOTS token into the pit-spot count field.
Clamp the pit-spot count field to a minimum of 52.
Apply the clamped pit-spot count (minimum 52).
Parse the GARAGESPOTS token into the garage-spot count field.
Clamp the garage-spot count field to a minimum of 3.
Apply the clamped garage-spot count (minimum 3).
Reallocate the mesh buffers now that the feature counts are known.
Detect the GRID section token for starting-grid position parsing.
Read grid-section lines until the section-marker token is found; grid slot index starts at -1.
Tokenize the current grid line.
Parse the GRIDINDEX token for the grid slot being defined.
Parse a grid position triple through the first offset variant.
Parse a grid position triple through the aligned variant; only slots below index 104 are written.
Write the parsed grid position into the grid-position array (base field 0x150, 28-byte stride, optional +12 alignment offset).
Detect the PITS section token for pit/garage position parsing.
Read pit-section lines until the section-marker token is found; team index starts at -1.
Tokenize the current pit line.
Parse the TEAMINDEX token for the team being defined.
Parse the PITPOS token and store the position triple in the pit-position array (field 0x154, 28-byte stride).
Parse the PITORI token and store the orientation triple in the pit-orientation slot (field 0x154 +12).
Parse the GARPOS token; convert the garage row value and index the garage-position array (field 0x158) by team index plus row times pit-spot count.
Parse the GARORI token and store the orientation triple in the garage-orientation slot (field 0x158 +12).
Stop the outer loop when a section-marker token with value 4 is read.
Parse the NUMBERWAYPOINT token for the waypoint count; on success allocate the waypoint array.
Allocate the waypoint array block (316 bytes per waypoint plus a 4-byte header) via the operator-new wrapper.
Run the per-waypoint constructor for each allocated slot (79 dwords per slot).
Store the allocated waypoint-array pointer in field 0x134 and the waypoint count in field 0x130.
Parse the LEFTHANDEDPITS token and store its boolean into the left-handed-pit flag field.
Parse the WORSTADJUST token into the worst-adjust field, clamped to at least 0.5.
Parse the MIDADJUST token into the mid-adjust field.
Parse the BESTADJUST token into the best-adjust field, clamped to at most 1.3.
Parse the RACEQUALRATIO token; if absent continue the parameter chain.
Parse the LAPLENGTH token.
Parse the SECTOR1LENGTH token.
Parse the SECTOR2LENGTH token.
Parse the FUELUSE token.
Parse the GROOVEWIDTH token.
Parse the GROOVEWIDTHWET token.
Parse the INTERMEDIATEFO token; on success feed the value to the clamped-reciprocal helper.
Store the two-value INTERMEDIATEFO0 result in the intermediate-fog globals.
Store the RAINYFOGPLANES result in the rainy-fog-plane globals.
Store the scaled INTERMEDIATEFO1 color components (0..255 scale factor ~0.0039) in the intermediate-fog color globals.
Store the scaled RAINYFOGCOLOR components in the rainy-fog color globals.
Store the FOGDENSITY result in the fog-density globals.
Parse RAINYDARKNESS and pass both values to the clamp-range helper.
Parse the WPB RANCHID token into the current waypoint's branch-id field.
Parse the WPPATH token into the current waypoint's path data.
Parse the WPEVENT token and store the two event integers in the waypoint record.
Parse the WPWPSE token into the waypoint's score/segment fields.
Parse the WPPOS token (position triple) and mirror it into the waypoint record's position fields.
Parse the WPGALPHA token for the waypoint alpha field.
Parse the WPGROOVELAT token for the waypoint groove-lateral field.
Parse the WPSCORE token; convert the float score to an integer stored in the waypoint record.
Parse the WPPERP token (perpendicular vector triple).
Parse the WPWIDTH token (width quadruple).
Parse the WPWIDTHD token (width-delta quadruple).
Parse the WPBITFIELDS token for the waypoint bit-field word.
Parse the WPPTRS token; on success advance the waypoint cursor to the next slot, guarded by the waypoint count field.
Fallback path when no waypoint count was parsed: install a default two-waypoint array.
Allocate the default two-slot waypoint array (count 2 stored in field 0x130, pointer in field 0x134, constructor run per slot).
Initialize default waypoint[0] fields: flag set to 1, state set to -1, float param set to 1.0, and zero/negative sentinels at the trailing fields.
Rebuild index remapping structures for the track database after parsing.
Post-process each parsed waypoint (316-byte stride) with the position-delta computation.
Return the result of the final post-processing call.

clean_pseudocode: // Parse track AI waypoint database file handle into the track object.
if (section(line, FEATURES)) { while (readLine(line)) { parse feature counts; clamp grids to 104/52/3; } allocateMeshBuffers(); }
if (section(line, GRID)) { while (readLine(line)) { parse grid slot positions into grid array; } }
if (section(line, PITS)) { while (readLine(line)) { parse team index + pit/garage pos/ori triples; } }
if (value(line, NUMBERWAYPOINT, &n)) { array = alloc(316*n+4); construct slots; waypoints = array; count = n; }
else parse track params (adjusts, lengths, fuel, groove, fog/weather);
parse per-waypoint fields (branch, path, event, score, width, groove, bitfields, ptrs);
if (ptrs) { if (index < count) { index++; waypoints = slot(index); } }
fallback: if (!count) { count = 2; waypoints = alloc(636); init 2 default slots with sentinels; }
remapIndexes(); for each parsed waypoint: computePositionDelta();
